core_obligations: Show that the scheme theoretic inverse image of Z_2 in Y_1 is a closed subspace through which f_1 factors (proof lines 3375-3378).
Use minimality of Z_1 to conclude that Z_1 is contained in it, which yields the induced morphism and the commutative diagram (proof lines 3378-3379).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a commutative square X_1 -> Y_1 over X_2 -> Y_2 of algebraic spaces over S with scheme theoretic images Z_i of f_i, the morphism Y_1 -> Y_2 induces a morphism Z_1 -> Z_2 making the displayed diagram commute (source lines 3353-3373). The proof shows that the scheme theoretic inverse image of Z_2 in Y_1 is a closed subspace of Y_1 through which f_1 factors, so that by the defining property of the scheme theoretic image Z_1 is contained in it, which gives the induced morphism.
